messages:
Sophie: Heads-up — ACME's reporting a renewal in 28 days and adoption has plateaued. Advanced feature set (chunked embeddings + reranking) shows almost no usage this quarter :warning:. Onboarding last interactive session 2025-06-02. Thinking we need a short save plan before they talk to procurement.

James: Saw the metrics — active users down ~40% last 2 weeks, embeddings requests dropped 62%. p95 latency for their top flow spiked to 1.8s. Might be them hitting batching/timeout thresholds.

Ana: +1. Proposed micro-save plan (quick, low friction):
1) 60m live enablement deep-dive for power users (recorded).
2) Deliver 3 tailored prompt templates + a tiny eval harness to show lift.
3) Offer a 30-day usage credit or temporary lenient overage policy.

Draft outreach (send after we lock time):
```
Subject: Quick enablement to stabilize ACME workflows before renewal
Hi Alex,
We noticed usage dropped and want to run a focused 1-hr session to unblock your power users and share ready-to-use prompt templates that map to your workflows. We’ll also run a quick eval to measure improvements live. Can we do Wed or Thu next week?
Best, Sophie (Redwood CSM)
```

Kevin: I can lead the enablement session — Wed 10–11am PST works for me. @Sophie can you pull the top 5 failing prompts + recent logs so I can prep demos?

Sophie: On it. I'll pull retention cohorts, top failing prompts, p50/p95 latency, and any errors. Quick checklist to prep before the call:
- Export top 5 failed prompts (by error/low-quality)
- Snapshot of usage by team and endpoint (last 30d)
- Short demo plan + 3 fixes to show in-session
- One-sheeter with recommended config tweaks (batching, cache TTLs)

Marta: renewal-bot: Reminder — ACME renewal due in 28 days. Renewal risk score: HIGH.

James: If they still want to downgrade, let's define an escape path so product doesn't break:
- Keep embeddings index live for search, but move long-running batch jobs to off-peak window
- Pin the model to a smaller variant for cost predictability
- Export user-owned data and provide simple re-ingest steps

Ana: Sharing the small eval script we'll use in-session (1-2 prompts, side-by-side):
```
# pseudo-eval snippet
prompts = ["summarize ticket", "extract action items"]
for p in prompts:
  baseline = call_api(model='open-archived')
  tuned = call_api(model='redwood-tuned', prompt=apply_template(p))
  print(metric(baseline, tuned))
```

Sophie: Plan: lock time today, send outreach tomorrow AM, run enablement next week, follow up with a targeted offer (30-day credit). Anyone object? :thumbsup: or suggest edits.

Kevin: :thumbsup: LGTM. I’ll prep slides and a quick demo dataset.

James: +1. After session we should a) run the eval, b) provide a reduced-cost pilot for 30 days, and c) escalate to AM if no adoption bump within 14 days.

Sophie: Great — I'll send calendar invite and the outreach draft once Kevin confirms slides. Thanks team.
